telemetry.title: 03. Topology geometry metrics
telemetry.tangentDesc: α = atan2(mean(|ηgeo|), mean(|γgeo|)); the angle formed by mean absolute display-vector components.
telemetry.tangentialDesc: Mean absolute normalized direction component; it is not torque-transfer efficiency.
telemetry.radialDesc: Mean absolute normalized direction component; it is not lateral stiffness.
telemetry.tangentRuntime: Mean absolute geometry for {count} drive-side spokes; individual absolute-angle range {min}°–{max}°. Display coordinates only, not measured mm.
telemetry.tangentialRuntime: mean(|ηgeo|) is the mean absolute tangential projection of the drive-side display vectors; it does not represent torque-transfer efficiency or wheel power.
telemetry.radialRuntime: mean(|γgeo|) is the mean absolute radial projection of the same display vectors; it does not represent lateral stiffness, tension, or riding performance.

review.title: 04. Topology mapping review
review.preview21Detail: The model draws seven rim-hole groups, 14 crossed drive-side spokes, and seven radial non-drive spokes; this only confirms the topology mapping.
review.preview21Tip: G3 and uniform-hole 24H 2:1 are separate topologies. Review the measured ERD, PCD (both diameters in mm), hole diameter, hole spacing, and flange offset for a real build.
review.noteTip: Use this page to review hole order and line relationships, then use manufacturer specifications and measured data for assembly decisions.
review.previewDetail: The {holes}H {cross}X hole-to-spoke mapping passed; the drive-side mean absolute display-projection angle is {angle}°, not a measured assembly result.
review.uniformTip: Uniform-hole 24H 2:1: 16 crossed drive-side spokes and eight radial non-drive spokes; review the rim's A-A-B hole sequence separately.
review.generalTip: This page confirms topology relationships only; a real wheel build requires measured ERD, PCD, flange spacing, hole diameter, and flange offset.

facts.title: Wheelset lacing topology reference facts
facts.intro: Use this page to inspect hole mapping and lacing line relationships. Standard 1:1, 21H G3 2:1 (14/7), and uniform-hole 24H 2:1 (16/8) are different topologies; metrics describe geometric projections only and do not replace spoke-length, tension, or assembly calculations.
facts.unitsValue: ERD and PCD are diameters; physical lengths use mm and angles use °.
facts.displayCoordinatesValue: SVG radii are canvas coordinates; the axial profile keeps reference offsets in mm and cannot replace calculator inputs.
facts.boundaryValue: This page does not call the spoke calculator or write back spoke-length or tension results.

notes.title: 05. Wheelset lacing topology rules and units
notes.radialBody: This page represents 0X as radial direct connections between hub and rim holes. It describes geometry only; suitability for a brake or drive side must be checked against hub and rim specifications.
notes.mappingBody: The page validates supported hole-count and crossing combinations as one-to-one topology mappings. Physical flange clearance and assembly checks remain outside this display page.
notes.asymmetricBody: 21H G3 uses grouped 14/7 hole positions; uniform-hole 24H 2:1 uses the A-A-B rim-hole sequence with 16/8 distribution. Both are 2:1 allocations, but they are separate topologies and are modeled separately.

seo.title: Wheelset spoke lacing topology and geometry reference
seo.description: An independent interactive reference for rim-hole mapping, 21H G3 2:1, uniform-hole 24H 2:1, and 0X–4X lacing. ERD and PCD are recorded as diameters in mm; metrics describe geometric projections only.
seo.headline: Wheelset spoke lacing topology and geometry reference
seo.keywords: wheelset lacing, spoke topology, G3 2:1, uniform-hole 2:1, ERD, PCD
seo.standardFactValue: Symmetric rim-hole allocation; 0X–4X crossing rules can be previewed.
seo.datasetDescription: The topology selections and measurement conventions exposed by this page. This is display data, not a measured wheel database and not a source of spoke length, tension, or assembly-safety conclusions.
seo.measurementTechnique: Deterministic hole mapping and mean absolute SVG-coordinate geometry projection.
